SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
MONDAY - MAY 16, 2022 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
* COVID-19 NOTICE *
To protect public health and safety during the COVID-19 pandemic and in compliance with the current State Department of Public Health and Los Angeles County Health Officer Orders and City of Cerritos COVID-19 Safety Plan, the City Council Chamber will be open to the public. As authorized by State of California Executive Orders N-25-20, N-29-20, and N-08-21, and subsequently by Assembly Bill 361 (Chapter 165, Statutes of 2021) and City Council Resolution No. 2022-10 adopted pursuant thereto, this meeting may also be conducted via teleconference, if necessary. Public observation and participation in this meeting will be facilitated through the methods described below.
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at www.cerritos.us and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1248 during regular business hours.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in-person in the Council Chamber subject to posted COVID-19 protocols.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in-person at the meeting or by using the following alternate methods:
Written correspondence (hard copy or email): Public comments can be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Office the City Clerk no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting. During the meeting, your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

minutes_text:
MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD MONDAY, MAY
16, 2022, 7:00 P.M., IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBER AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125
BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA.

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Mayor/Chair Vo.

3.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Lynda P. Johnson
  Council/Agency Member Naresh Solanki
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Bruce Barrows
  Mayor/Chair Chuong Vo

4.  Public Comments

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to provide public comment, the Mayor declared the public comments period
  closed.

5.  New Business

5A.  Review and consideration of the Fiscal Year 2022-2023 Preliminary Combined Financial
  Program for the City of Cerritos and the Successor Agency to the Cerritos Redevelopment
  Agency (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  Staff reports were provided by Jeff Thielke, Budget Manager, Peter Kemp, Accountant,
  Dario Simoes, Deputy Director Public Works/City Engineer, and Ryan Carey, Finance
  Manager. A PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  CONSENSUS (Barrows): Directed the City Manager to separate private monetary
  donations from City-assigned funds held in the CCPA Endowment Fund (Code 112) in the
  FY 2022-23 budget document for accounting purposes.

  CONSENSUS (Barrows): Directed the City Manager to fund education, conference, and
  training for Charter Employees, City Employees, and City Appointed Commissioners in
  Fiscal Year 2022-23.

  CONSENSUS (Barrows): Directed the City Manager to provide an agenda report
  consider repealing the current truck route ordinance, thereby restoring the truck routes
  that were previously in place, inclusive of noticing all property owners within 500 feet of
  all affected truck routes.

  CONSENSUS (Barrows): Directed the City Manager to fund and complete the Potable
  Water Master Plan Development (CIP Project Number 23504) in Fiscal Year 2022-23.

  CONSENSUS (Barrows): Directed the City Manager to fund and complete the Sewer
  Master Plan Development (CIP Project Number 23603) in Fiscal Year 2022-23.

5.  New Business (continued)

5A.  (continued)

  CONSENSUS (Barrows): Directed the City Manager to fund and complete the City Hall
  Security Improvements for Council Offices, Human Resources, and Administrative
  Services (3rd floor) (CIP Project Number 23204) in Fiscal Year 2022-23.

  CONSENSUS (Barrows): Directed the City Manager to fund and complete the City Hall
  Security Improvements (1st and 2nd floors) (CIP Project Number 23204) in Fiscal Year
  2023-24.

  CONSENSUS (Barrows): Directed the City Manager to fund and complete the Council
  Chamber Audio/Video Equipment Upgrades (CIP Project Number 22201) in Fiscal Year
  2022-23.

  CONSENSUS (Vo): Directed the City Manager to fund and complete the Heritage Park
  Lake Cleaning (CIP Project No. 23111) in Fiscal Year 2022-23.

  CONSENSUS (Vo): Directed the City Manager to fund and complete the Heritage Park
  Island and Lake Improvements Erosion Mitigation (CIP Project Number 23101) in Fiscal
  Year 2022-23.

  CONSENSUS (Vo): Directed the City Manager via the City’s Risk Management Division
  to work in collaboration with the JPIA to formulate a plan to reduce the City’s exposure to
  liability claims and provide an agenda report to the City Council with findings for their
  consideration.

  CONSENSUS (Vo): Directed the City Manager provide an agenda report regarding the
  City’s use of social media, including: 1) upgrading the City’s existing Facebook Group to
  an official City Facebook Page allowing for public comments to be posted on said page
  without the requirement for City staff to respond; and 2) commencing the use of the
  Twitter and Instagram platforms for communicating official City business.

  CONSENSUS (Vo): Directed the City Manager to provide an agenda report to return the
  Cerritos Senior Center hours of operation to the pre-pandemic level.

  CONSENSUS (Vo): Directed the City Manager to provide an agenda report to adjust
  COW bus service hours of operation to the pre-pandemic level, including analysis on the
  feasibility of adjusting the COW schedule to align with school start times.

  CONSENSUS (Yokoyama): Directed the City Manager to provide an agenda report to
  return the Cerritos Library hours of operation to the pre-pandemic level.

6.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 11:08 p.m.

  /s/ Vida Barone  __________
  Vida Barone, City Clerk/Agency Secretary
